caption: The video captures a speckled tan-and-gray granite countertop under warm indoor light, on which two bowls sit side by side. The larger bowl at the left is white and holds a smooth, pale, glossy substance resting in its shallow base. The smaller bowl at the right is polished stainless steel and contains several ice cubes clustered together in its lower half. In the upper right corner, the sandaled lower legs and feet of a person appear briefly on the beige tiled floor and are then no longer visible. Apart from this brief background appearance, the bowls and their contents show no visible displacement, shifting, or melting. Toward the end, a faint reddish reflection surfaces in the upper interior of the metal bowl and persists there to the end.
